You can capture and use screenshots in ChatGPT `through built-in desktop features, operating system shortcuts, or browser extensions depending on your device`.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-long-screenshot-e/mndfgfiilicfiimckjnlekaiepfihpci)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF15mtxrirC7lDtIl24xMyYVtsM9u9aCRyeojzfC3wh6XRQMHVKU8Lb9FxcuGSjbHLYR3HI-NeczJWALORnHbL1YdTzkZc2G43f5Md8YFPq_v5k4YVAyuEmpVa8RQjovsI8CbrQ6icoUoYDBi5hB7SipBSM9CxJ0hIFDeaQFArQ3GUulkaWKQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES3QEBxCJF14bVHmtZAsxp_LuQ-NH0ebl4GPh6khqlEO3aVYemRqihAhaPi-7rGjeyFs69yQICF4rxJvEoTCmR_pYGOtbV1KXkNTm0qMfZWQxf0-qAt9rrNi2oSeZ0y4ou7ihvzX1fo6nS_t2R-AkmTxUjzS-Dco2DDB2Ngc0MAmpSTsRf4gMwj1T0cxw_zkDqZmjWlBRZyWMo-QnXeXT0BQTMk97UTLOU74tKrDJU2UMPN4DA9MSeZC-quWJ4tjHI3MsRyDF6SREGi0bHzdqEXQ_QeefqpYK_SBqz0wg0QQ)

### 1. ChatGPT macOS App (Built-in Screenshot Tool)

- Open the ChatGPT macOS app or its launcher and click the **Plus (`+` ) icon**.
- Hover over **Take Screenshot** to pick from your currently open application windows, or type an app name directly.
- *Note:* You must grant ChatGPT screen and audio recording permissions in your macOS **System Settings** , then restart the app.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF15mtxrirC7lDtIl24xMyYVtsM9u9aCRyeojzfC3wh6XRQMHVKU8Lb9FxcuGSjbHLYR3HI-NeczJWALORnHbL1YdTzkZc2G43f5Md8YFPq_v5k4YVAyuEmpVa8RQjovsI8CbrQ6icoUoYDBi5hB7SipBSM9CxJ0hIFDeaQFArQ3GUulkaWKQ)

### 2. Standard OS-Level Screenshots (Windows & Mac)

- **Windows:** Press `Win + Shift + S` to capture a snip of your screen, then paste it directly (`Ctrl + V` ) into the ChatGPT chat input box.
- **Mac:** Press `Cmd + Shift + 4` (or `Cmd + Ctrl + Shift + 4` to copy to your clipboard) and paste it into ChatGPT (`Cmd + V`).
- *Tip:* Pasting images or text snips directly retains formatting, code blocks, and data tables much better than copying and pasting raw text.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXvxX1ydxl2Bmvs0z4F162Qd0AcT_bhckjzpVzDrxojsmfiha49g3s5SWS2deycSQDJcPuO5jfndrspQF4jH8yYDaoNOZBOPMkGJgdqJFRTznq52XmqP6JLS1-2_o3HSojwos)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES3QEBxCJF14bVHmtZAsxp_LuQ-NH0ebl4GPh6khqlEO3aVYemRqihAhaPi-7rGjeyFs69yQICF4rxJvEoTCmR_pYGOtbV1KXkNTm0qMfZWQxf0-qAt9rrNi2oSeZ0y4ou7ihvzX1fo6nS_t2R-AkmTxUjzS-Dco2DDB2Ngc0MAmpSTsRf4gMwj1T0cxw_zkDqZmjWlBRZyWMo-QnXeXT0BQTMk97UTLOU74tKrDJU2UMPN4DA9MSeZC-quWJ4tjHI3MsRyDF6SREGi0bHzdqEXQ_QeefqpYK_SBqz0wg0QQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXcea1b92REKaTdz1ifv1cyEpZdPEu5VnVpsNIAVqYg3akZ4tSpJMx3oAsXduYtLTqbGksCfi3u5i77aBYaYUSYBl2CAU-PUDLD-GtuAvznfHitK0dCww8qYutuCGEVR7yYoU)

### 3. Capturing Full or Long ChatGPT Conversations

- **Chrome Extensions:** To export entire long chat threads as a single image or PDF instead of taking manual patchwork screenshots, you can use browser tools like the [ChatGPT Long Screenshot Exporter](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-long-screenshot-e/mndfgfiilicfiimckjnlekaiepfihpci?hl=en) or [chatGPT screenshot](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-screenshot/nobfenidifcdghhkifkcnlhmnlfnmhek?hl=en) from the Chrome Web Store.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-screenshot/nobfenidifcdghhkifkcnlhmnlfnmhek)[[2]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-long-screenshot-e/mndfgfiilicfiimckjnlekaiepfihpci)
